title: The Game Of Life
description: This mod adds various cellular automota that will mess up your world.
body:
# The game of life
This mod adds a few cellular autamota to play with (i might add more). 
These cellular automota will break blocks in your world and cause lag. also they may come from one world to another so be careful with this mc instance if you want to make every cell currently working stop just close your game and re open it and they will become inert.

Have Fun
